items.title: The last mile of a long road: faster NumPy in the browser
items.blurb: NumPy on Emscripten-forge now links OpenBLAS in WebAssembly, with large speedups for matmul and linear algebra in the browser.

items.title: Page Rage: Take Out Your Stress on a Web Page
items.blurb: Page Rage is a free game that lets you destroy any page. Dealing with things in a healthy way is overrated. Hide from your problems and break things instead!
